newsitem.title: UK: Cellnet to invest 1 billion stg - paper.
newsitem.headline: Cellnet to invest 1 billion stg - paper.

text.p: Cellnet, the UK mobile telephones group 60 percent owned by British Telecommunications is to spend an extra one billion stg over the next five years to extend geographic coverage to 80 percent of Britain, the Financial Times (FT) said on Thursday.
The network improvement plans are crucial to its plans to introduce advanced "third generation" services from the year 2001 onwards, the FT said.
The network, Britain's second biggest, now covers 70 percent of the country and is available to about 98 percent of the population. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
